title: Amount
description: Integer atomic units for any asset-denominated quantity (money, limits). No JSON floats in hash scope. Asset is a namespaced reference so fiat and crypto are unambiguous.

value.description: Base-10 integer atomic units (string clears the 2^53 JSON-number ceiling).

decimals.description: Asset scale (e.g. 2 for iso4217:EUR minor units, 6 for USDC).

asset.description: Namespaced asset reference. Fiat: iso4217:<CODE> (e.g. iso4217:EUR). Crypto: caip19:<CAIP-19 asset id> (e.g. caip19:eip155:8453/erc20:0x…).
